From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Subject: Mid-quarter leadership pulse: ownership swaps, dependency asks, and QBR artifacts

Team —

Quick mid-quarter snapshot and a set of asks so we can close the QBR pack next week. I reviewed the midQ metrics and the attached midq_pulse.xlsx / dependency_grid.pdf; high level:

1) Objective A (Hosted API adoption) — on track for usage, but growth is gated by the Dedicated capacity rollout for a key customer (HealthCo). We need a clear owner for the Dedicated throughput SLAs and a runbook for capacity handoffs.

2) Objective B (Cost optimization via batching & quant) — pilot results are promising but depend on the quant engineering spike (Q-quant). Without infra assistance we will not reach the 25% token-cost improvement target.

3) Objective C (Enterprise readiness) — procurement + SOC2 artifacts requested by HealthCo; procurement timeline will drive our demo cadence.

Asks (actionable, with proposed owners):
- Transfer ownership of "Dedicated throughput commitment" to Markus (owner: markus@redwood.com). Deliver: capacity runbook + target numbers by 2026-09-24. See dependency_grid.pdf.
- Vanessa: reassign 0.5 FTE from Feature X to support quant pilot and prepare a short results slide for the QBR (due 2026-09-22).
- Naomi: pull final telemetry for "Route latency (p50/p95)" and token-cost trends from Console; I need the numbers + 2-sentence callout for the QBR by EOD 2026-09-20.
- I'll own exec narrative and QBR slide deck consolidation; drop comments on the shared doc: https://redwood.app/drive/midq_pulse_2026

Also: HealthCo asked for SOC2 evidence and procurement terms; I'm copying our contact list and will forward their email once internal owners are assigned.

Attachments: midq_pulse.xlsx (workbook), dependency_grid.pdf (matrix).

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Product & GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick updates:
